exposure: negative cognitions (about the self, world, life, future, and self-blame)
type of perinatal loss (before or after birth)
cohort: The study included 98 perinatally bereaved mothers with a mean age of 33.9 years.
finding: Maladaptive cognitions about life, the future, and the world were associated with prolonged grief symptoms, while cognitions about the world were associated with depressive symptoms, with specific associations varying based on whether the death occurred before or after birth.
